mapper.select: SELECT E.EXERCISE_ID /* 운동아이디 */ , E.NAME /* 운동명 */ , E.BODY_PART_CD /* 대표부위코드 */ , E.EQUIPMENT_CD /* 요구장비코드 */ , BPD.DTL_CD_NM AS BODY_PART_NM /* 대표부위코드명 */ , EQD.DTL_CD_NM AS EQUIPMENT_NM /* 요구장비코드명 */ , E.IMAGE_FILE_ID /* 이미지파일아이디 */ , E.REG_DT /* 등록일시 */ , E.MOD_DT /* 변경일시 */ FROM EXERCISES E LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE_DTL BPD ON BPD.COM_CD_ID = 'BODY_PART_CD' AND BPD.DTL_CD_ID = E.BODY_PART_CD LEFT JOIN CMM_CODE_DTL EQD ON EQD.COM_CD_ID = 'EXERCISE_EQUIPMENT_CD' AND EQD.DTL_CD_ID = E.EQUIPMENT_CD WHERE E.EXERCISE_ID = #{exerciseId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
